answer: Admission requires an ivory seal: a memory-hard sequential proof that cannot be parallelized, so a farm's N machines finish no faster than one. Each seal is bound to a challenge echo — the sponsor must repeat the newcomer's salted hash within one epoch, proving a live human link. If the newcomer cheats, a ripple runs through the attestation graph: every sponsor within two hops loses stake proportional to the square of the number of bad seals they touched, so ten clones cost a hundredfold. Honest sponsors keep their seals; farms drown in their own ripple.
